_metadata.title: SRCP Resource Renewal Demo
_metadata.description: Demonstrates how Waldur with user actions can replace manual SRCP renewal forms. Includes all 3 SRCP services: Secure Windows Desktop, Virtual HPC, and REDCap. Shows expiring resources at multiple urgency levels, pending renewal orders, and users with different permission levels.
scenarios: Permission testing - MANAGER can approve orders
Permission testing - MEMBER can view but not approve
Multiple offering types: Windows, vHPC, REDCap
_metadata.date_note: End dates are relative to 2026-01-15. Adjust dates before demo if needed.

users.alice_pi: Principal Investigator - MANAGER role, can approve orders
users.carol_analyst: Data Analyst - MEMBER role, view only

projects.name: SRCP Research Project

offerings.name: Secure Windows Desktop
offerings.description: Microsoft Windows remote desktop solution with dedicated secure group storage and additional access controls for researchers requiring Windows environments.
offerings.full_description:
SRCP Secure Windows Desktop provides secure access to Windows environments for processing sensitive research data. Includes:
- Dedicated Windows VM
- Secure group storage
- Multi-factor authentication
- ISO 27001 certified environment

offerings.name: Virtual HPC
offerings.description: Linux-based virtualized high performance computing platform providing access to CPU and GPU servers within private virtual environments.
offerings.full_description:
SRCP Virtual HPC enables complex data analysis on sensitive information with security controls similar to CSD3. Includes:
- CPU and GPU compute nodes
- Private virtual environments
- Secure data storage
- Job scheduling system

offerings.name: REDCap
offerings.description: Secure web-based platform for research data collection, management, and analysis. Self-managed REDCap within SRCP secure environment.
offerings.full_description:
SRCP REDCap provides secure research data collection and survey management. Includes:
- Survey creation tools
- Data validation
- Multi-site support
- Audit trail
- CAM:IDE Safe Haven integration available
